title: Yunus in the belly of the fish

phrases.text: A prophet… swallowed by a giant fish, deep in the sea.
This is the story of Prophet Yunus, peace be upon him.
He left his people in anger, and boarded a fully loaded ship.
Lots were drawn on board, and he lost.
Then a giant fish swallowed him.
Alone, in darkness upon darkness, he called out to his Lord.
Allah answered him, and saved him from his distress. And so does He save the believers.
The fish cast him onto the shore, and Allah made a gourd plant grow over him.
No darkness is too deep for a sincere prayer. Share this with someone who needs it.

q: sun rays through clouds over sea

caption:
In the darkness of the sea, one prayer reached the heavens 🌊
The story of Prophet Yunus (peace be upon him).
Save it for the day you need it.
